content:
Overview

Mecca is a city in Makkah with a population of 2,150,000. The holiest city in Islam, birthplace of the Prophet Muhammad, and destination of the annual Hajj pilgrimage. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 310 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.0.
